name: cite-pills
title: Citation pills
description: Textbook-style citations ("Ex 1.2 · p. 42") as small pills with an icon, optionally linking to the page in a PDF.

icon.description: Icon before each pill and the section source line: "book", "page" or "none".

pageLabel.description: Text added after the citation when it has data-page; {page} is replaced. Empty = no page text.

title.description: Tooltip of pills with a page; {page} and {pdfPage} are replaced. Empty = none.

offset.description: Added to a numeric data-page to get {pdfPage} (the PDF's page index when printed page numbers do not start at 1). An element's data-pdf-page wins.

href.description: null, or a link template such as "source.pdf#page={pdfPage}" (fields {page} {pdfPage}); when set, pills with a page become links.

newTab.description: Open pill links in a new tab.

sourcePill.description: Also style the section source line (p.src under each h2) as a pill with the same icon.

sources.description: Several sources: {"id": {icon, pageLabel, title, offset, href}} overrides for elements with data-source="id".

requirePage.description: Make `study.py check` report every .cite without data-page (or a .pg child).
